data.did_you_know: The artist was the grandfather of author E. B. White.
data.description: William Hart painted several compositions similar to Autumn Scene in the Adirondacks, in which trees arch over a stream, framing a distant view of sky. This example is unusual because of its inclusion of deer--visible in the shadows at lower left--which rarely appear in the artist's works.
